Sunday, 12th September 2027]
[b]Saunday, 12th September 2027 | 1:00 PM Nestor Ocean Time |  Shuri Castle (首里城), Shurikinjocho District (首里金城町地区), Yamakagutsuchi (山カグツチ), Ryūkyū Province (琉球国), Iōjima Prefecture (硫黄島県), Anunshotō (暗雲諸島)[/b]

The coronation of Hamahiga Osahito has taken place today in the private Daidō shrine at Shuri Castle today. Those present were the entirety of the [i]Shodaigōzoku[/i], the [i]Dainishizokus[/i] (第二氏族), and the many Kannushis (神主) of the Daidō faith. The coronation was also the first to include photographers within the ceremony, however, the photographers, who worked for the [i]Sunao Times[/i], were prohibited from taking photos until after the ceremony.

The ceremony included the Three Sacred Treasures, the hallmarks of legitimacy of the Tenshō. The Three Sacred Treasures are the [i]Yata no Kagami[/i] (八咫鏡) bronze mirror, the [i]Yasakani no Magatama[/i] (八尺瓊勾玉) jade [i]Magatama[/i], and the [i]Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi[/i] (草薙の剣) sword. These three gifts signify that the emperor is the descendant of Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi, and Susanoo. Hamahiga Osahito emerged into the courtyard of the Shuri Palace with the [i]Kusanagi-no-Tsurugi[/i] sword in His right hand, the [i]Yasakani no Magatama[/i] in His left hand, and the [i]Yata no Kagami[/i] carried beside him by the [i]Saiō[/i] Hamahiga Sumiko (whom is also the Tenshō's half-sister).

The [i]Kunaichō[/i] has announced that the 24[sup]th[/sup] Tenshō of Anunshotō has proclaimed His enthronement name to be is "Kazuya" (カズヤ) which means "one harmony; peace". The posthumous name of the 23[sup]rd[/sup] Tenshō of Anunshotō has also been announced and that is "Tsuyoshi" (剛志).
[/spoiler]
